judged_text: Google Calendar credential keys get corrupted on first refresh: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the zod safeParse wrapper ({success, data, error}) instead of .data, and CalendarService stores it directly as credential.key, so subsequent reads of credential.key.access_token/.refresh_token return undefined and Google Calendar sync breaks permanently for that credential (Zoom/O365/Salesforce call sites work because they consume the wrapper shape)

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed credential `key` is set to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and then stored directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) returns the Zod `safeParse` result wrapper (`{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed `.data`. Other call sites (e.g. O365/Salesforce) treat the return value as this wrapper and extract `.data`, but Google Calendar does not—so it will persist the wrapper object as `credential.key`, corrupting the expected credential shape for subsequent reads.
